scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: The agent followed a reasonable investigation process (finding the file, checking errors, listing projects, querying properties) but arrived at fundamentally incorrect conclusions. The most critical error was asserting LrgWindowsAppManifest was built as part of the solution when it wasn't, which cascaded into missing the actual root cause. The agent confused 'projects referenced in the binlog' with 'projects actually built,' and failed to notice configuration mismatches. While the error identification and project listing were partially useful, the core diagnostic questions were answered incorrectly.

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
